overview_description.description:
Memora Health, the leading intelligent care enablement platform, helps clinicians focus on top-of-license practice while proactively engaging patients along complex care journeys. Memora partners with leading health systems, health plans, and digital health companies to transform the care delivery process for care teams and patients. Our platform digitizes and automates high-touch clinical workflows, supercharging care teams by intelligently triaging patient-reported concerns and data to appropriate care team members and providing patients with proactive, two-way communication and support. 

Memora Health is headquartered in San Francisco, CA, with clients and team members around the country, and is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Transformation Capital, General Catalyst, AlleyCorp, Frist Cressey Ventures, Martin Ventures, Kevin Durant and Rich Kleiman's Thirty Five Ventures, and several other strategic healthcare groups.

To learn more about Memora’s vision to make care more actionable, accessible and always-on, visit memorahealth.com.

identifier.value: Memora Health Intelligent Care Enablement Platform

product.name: Memora Health Intelligent Care Enablement Platform
product.description: A platform that integrates with existing healthcare systems to automate and simplify complex care workflows using AI, supporting care teams and patients throughout care journeys.

product.name: Remote Patient Monitoring Integration
product.description: A service that collects and organizes data from remote patient monitoring devices to provide actionable insights for healthcare providers.

product.name: Automated Patient Engagement and Communication
product.description: An AI-driven system that automates patient interactions including appointment reminders, symptom checks, medication adherence prompts, and education via SMS and other digital channels.

product.name: Clinical Workflow Automation
product.description: Technology that automates routine clinical tasks and administrative processes to reduce clinician workload and improve care coordination.

product.name: Value-Based Care Support Services
product.description: A suite of tools and services that assist healthcare organizations in implementing and scaling value-based care models through data integration, patient engagement, and care coordination.
